capture_method: Native PrintWindow(PW_CLIENTONLY | PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) from the authorized application HWND; 120 sequential frames at 15 Hz, encoded to H.264 using existing ffmpeg

verification.visual_inspection: First and last source frames show rotating native cube only. The target HWND capture excludes desktop content and occluding windows.

failed_attempt.result: Rejected during visual QA because a firewall dialog occluded the client rectangle; discarded private video and thumbnails, no raw failed recording published.

scope: Current M4.1 fixed-mesh motion. Recording cadence is independent of runtime frame rate and is not performance evidence.
